title: Tonelli in the coordinates ℝ^{m+1} = ℝ × ℝ^m
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ and F : ℝ^{m+1} → [0, ∞] be Borel. For t ∈ ℝ and v ∈ ℝ^m let [t,v] ∈ ℝ^{m+1} be the point (t, v_0, …, v_{m−1}), i.e. (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons t (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ v)). Then t ↦ ∫_{ℝ^m} F([t,v]) dL^m(v) is Borel measurable and ∫_{ℝ^{m+1}} F dL^{m+1} = ∫_ℝ ∫_{ℝ^m} F([t,v]) dL^m(v) dt (Lebesgue measures = volume).
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ≥0∞), Measurable F → Measurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ v : Eucl m, F ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons t (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ v)))) ∧ ∫⁻ y, F y = ∫⁻ t : ℝ, ∫⁻ v : Eucl m, F ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons t (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ v)))
